item.title: Howto Setup your own blog in Github with custom domain
item.description:
For this purpose I have picked Github because of several things. First of all is that it renders markdown files better than any competitor out there. Besides that, they allow seamless integration of custom domain to Github Pages. Basically there are many ways of hosting one's website. You could choose bloated WordPress or go for something easy to maintain and recyclable. Make sure you have cloned Manpageblog from Github. Before you set up anything else, make sure you have created a repository in Github. Follow the instructions in the Github page, and set up the site. Make sure to edit blog.conf to make changes as you'd wish. Now commit the code to the repository you have created earlier. Next, make sure your custom domain is tied to cloudflare free tier platform because it allows easy DNS management like nobody else in this planet. Once you have all that prepared, link ...

item.title: My adventure with Claude Code
item.description:
manpageblog I have been used Claude Code for quite some time now. Like before openclaw? I used to have $100 plan back then. Models back then were quite 'dumb' however they tend to get harness like work done properly. Eversince Claude subscription was used with OpenClaw, Anthropic had to crack down on addtional, 'dumb' usage and charge them separately. While this move is welcomed, people should prefer using their opensource models hosted elsewhere because it obviously hurts other users relying on the platform. So far I have done countless number of applications with Claude Code and it is not about marketablity of the product rather the joy of using it for a long term. First of all, you don't own the code so you wouldn't know what is exactly happening under the hood. Even if you have all figured out, touching one end of the product will have ripple effects ...
